prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Teslan Veyr. Character visual motifs: coil scientist with portable ground rods, insulated coat with hazard seams, copper articulated monocle.
TOP LEFT: Closed Circuit. Ability concept: a successful link between two Teslan rods grants a stored Capacitor charge, maximum 2.
TOP RIGHT: Drive Rod. Ability concept: place a destructible rod at a ground point, 140 GU range, 3 s lifetime after the second rod. Two rods generate a clearly drawn current beam between them; crossing once damages lightly.
BOTTOM LEFT: Reverse Current. Ability concept: flips the circuit to **Repel** or **Conduct** for 2.5 s. Repel deflects enemy projectiles crossing the beam slightly; Conduct increases allied attack speed when standing adjacent to the line. Each hero may benefit once per cast.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Brownout Protocol. Ability concept: consumes Capacitors to briefly shut down **deployables** and delay the next cast windup of enemies who remain on the circuit line (up to 0.5 s); opponents can walk away before the 0.75 s charge finishes. It does not silence globally or auto-pull.
